_about: CMS quality and reimbursement reference for diabetic retinal screening. Summaries for orientation only; verify codes, rules and payment with your Medicare Administrative Contractor (MAC).

measures.name: Diabetes: Eye Exam
measures.what: Patients 18 to 75 with diabetes who had a retinal or dilated eye exam by an eye care professional in the measurement period, or a negative exam in the prior year.
measures.how: A screening read and signed by an eye care professional counts toward closing the gap. A signed specialist response in Insight Rx is the evidence to record.

measures.name: Eye Exam for Patients With Diabetes
measures.owner: NCQA (used in Medicare Advantage Star Ratings)
measures.what: Retinal eye exam for members with diabetes; retinal imaging read by an eye care professional or a qualifying AI system counts.
measures.how: Closing EED gaps moves Star Ratings, which drive Medicare Advantage bonus payments to health plans.

codes.name: Retinal imaging, remote clinical staff review and report
codes.fit: Store-and-forward capture with review by clinical staff (no physician interpretation).

codes.name: Retinal imaging, remote physician or QHP interpretation and report
codes.fit: Insight Rx's workflow: photos captured at point of care, interpreted and signed by a physician.

codes.name: Retinal imaging, point-of-care automated analysis and report
codes.fit: Autonomous AI with an FDA-cleared device. Insight Rx is not FDA-cleared, so this does not apply today.
